Title: Guest adds a product from the catalogue
Steps:
1. Open home page
2. Click the product
3. Note the price
4. Click 'Add to cart'
5. Accept the alert
6. Open Cart
Expected Result: Alert 'Product added' shown; cart has exactly 1 line with the same title and price; Total equals that price.

Title: Empty cart shows no lines and no total
Steps: 1. Open cart.html in a fresh session
Expected Result: No product rows; Total is empty; 'Place Order' button visible.

Title: Cart of one guest is not visible to another guest
Steps:
1. Session A: add a product
2. Session B (new browser context): open Cart
Expected Result: Session B cart is empty.

Title: Logged-in user adds a product
Steps:
1. Log in
2. Open product page
3. Click 'Add to cart'
4. Open Cart
Expected Result: Alert 'Product added.'; cart shows the product with correct title and price.

Title: Total equals the sum of several different products
Test Data: Samsung galaxy s6, Sony vaio i5, Apple monitor 24 (phone, laptop, monitor)
Steps:
1. Add the three products
2. Open Cart
Expected Result: 3 lines with the correct titles; Total = sum of the three product-page prices.

Title: Adding the same product twice
Steps:
1. Add Nexus 6
2. Add Nexus 6 again
3. Open Cart
Expected Result: Two separate lines (no quantity column); Total = 2 × price.

Title: Deleting a line updates the cart and total
Preconditions: Cart has Samsung galaxy s6 + Apple monitor 24
Steps:
1. Open Cart
2. Click 'Delete' on Samsung galaxy s6
Expected Result: Line removed after reload; only Apple monitor 24 remains; Total = its price.

Title: Deleting the last line leaves an empty cart
Steps:
1. Open Cart
2. Delete the only line
Expected Result: Cart empty; Total empty.

Title: Cart persists across logout and login
Steps:
1. Add a product
2. Log out
3. Log in again
4. Open Cart
Expected Result: The product is still in the cart (server-side cart).

Title: Items added via API are rendered in the UI cart
Steps:
1. Add products through the API
2. Open Cart in the UI
Expected Result: UI shows both lines; Total = sum of their API prices.

Title: Cart line layout
Steps:
1. Open Cart
2. Inspect each row
Expected Result: Each row shows Pic, Title, Price and a 'Delete' link; headers Pic/Title/Price/x.

Title: Double-click 'Add to cart'
Steps:
1. Open product page
2. Double-click 'Add to cart' quickly
3. Open Cart
Expected Result: Behaviour is defined: either 1 or 2 lines, matching the number of 'Product added' alerts.

Title: Open cart via direct URL
Steps: 1. Type https://www.demoblaze.com/cart.html in the address bar
Expected Result: Cart loads with all lines and correct total.

Title: Invalid product id
Steps:
1. Open prod.html?idp_=99999
2. Click 'Add to cart' if shown
3. Open Cart
Expected Result: Graceful 'not found' handling; no empty/undefined line added to the cart.

Title: Network failure while adding
Steps:
1. Open product page
2. Go offline
3. Click 'Add to cart'
Expected Result: User is informed the item was not added; no false 'Product added' alert.

Title: Guest cart after logging in
Steps:
1. As guest add an item
2. Log in
3. Open Cart
Expected Result: Defined behaviour (merge or keep separate) — document actual result.

Title: Large cart (20+ lines)
Steps:
1. Add 20 items (API seeding)
2. Open Cart
Expected Result: All lines render; Total correct; page loads within performance budget.

Title: Deleting one of two identical lines
Steps:
1. Open Cart
2. Delete one Nexus 6 line
Expected Result: Exactly one Nexus 6 line remains.

Title: Cart in two tabs
Steps:
1. Open Cart in tabs A and B
2. Delete an item in A
3. Reload B
Expected Result: B reflects the deletion after reload.

Title: Guest cart after clearing cookies
Steps:
1. Clear site cookies
2. Open Cart
Expected Result: Cart is empty (guest cart tied to cookie).

Title: Add to cart on all browsers / mobile
Steps: 1. Run TC-CART-001 and TC-CART-004 on every project
Expected Result: Same behaviour on Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, Pixel 7, iPhone 14.
